messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — bringing up lyra-20b on the runtime with q4 quant. Getting kv-cache shape/rotary mismatches on startup, want to triage before we run full evals.
jonathan: Can you paste the runtime error and the model config you used? :eyes:
mira: Error snippet:
```
./serve --model lyra20b --quant q4
ERROR: kv_state.shape mismatch: expected (4,256,64) got (4,128,64)
Attention check failed: rotary_freq/base mismatch (runtime=2048, model=10000)
```
mira: Model config excerpt (from model_card):
```
rotary_base: 10000
rotary_scale: none
kv_cache_style: rope-rotary
```
ark: Sounds like a RoPE base mismatch — some exported checkpoints use legacy 10000, our runtime defaults to 2048 for performance. Two quick paths: (1) add a rope-compat shim in runtime that rescales frequencies, (2) adapt model loader to rewrite rotary params at load time.
ark: Also check whether kv stride/heads got folded during quant conversion. The shape mismatch (256 vs 128) could be half-precision packing differences after q4 packing.
sara: For prioritization: if shim fixes it reliably, that's the fastest way to unblock evals. Please run a short smoke with seq_len=32 and compare logits on first 10 tokens before we run full evals.
mira: Running smoke now with --seq-len 32 and the shim flag (--rope-compat=legacy). Output:
```
smoke run: ./serve --model lyra20b --quant q4 --seq-len 32 --rope-compat=legacy
result: start ok, 2/2 inferences complete
logits cmp: first10_token_l2=0.0032 (within acceptable threshold)
perf: token/s dropped ~6% vs runtime default
```
jonathan: Good sign. Can you also try the conversion with the runtime's packer disabled (flag --no-q4-packer) to rule out packing shape change?
mira: Tried --no-q4-packer: got same kv shape mismatch earlier, so packing is related. Packer path transforms kv layout; combined with rope base mismatch produced the observed shape mismatch.
ark: Action items: (a) short-term: enable --rope-compat=legacy for lyra20b onboarding branch so eng-ml can run overnight evals, (b) medium-term: add loader normalization step that reconciles rotary_base and kv packing metadata during model import, (c) long-term: add unit tests for packer+rope combos.
eng-runtime: Noted. I'll pick up loader normalization tomorrow — will open a PR with tests and a micro-benchmark. Tagging ticket infra: #4521.
ci-bot: CI: created job perf/lyra20b-compat-4521 and queued nightly evals.
mira: Thanks — I'll let evals run overnight and post diffs in a follow-up thread. Leaving rope-compat enabled for now. :thumbsup:
jonathan: Awesome. If overnight evals show any quality regression, we'll rollback to fp16 host for critical routes and continue optimizations in dev branch.
mira: assigning follow-ups: @ark (pack+shape audit), @eng-runtime (loader PR), @sara (overnight evals analysis).
